execution.raw_text:
```sql
SELECT 
  md.chembl_id, 
  md.pref_name, 
  cs.canonical_smiles, 
  md.max_phase, 
  dm.mechanism_of_action, 
  dm.action_type, 
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, 
  td.pref_name AS target_name
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON md.molregno = dm.molregno
JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE md.max_phase = 4 
  AND dm.action_type = 'BLOCKER'
ORDER BY 
  md.chembl_id ASC, 
  md.pref_name ASC, 
  cs.canonical_smiles ASC, 
  md.max_phase ASC, 
  dm.mechanism_of_action ASC, 
  dm.action_type ASC, 
  td.chembl_id ASC, 
  td.pref_name ASC
```
